title: Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir meets Prime Minister
body_text: Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir, Shri Manoj Sinha met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi. The Prime Minister’s Office wrote on X; “Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir, Shri @manojsinha_ , met Prime Minister @narendramodi. @OfficeOfLGJandK” Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir, Shri @manojsinha_ , met Prime Minister @narendramodi . @OfficeOfLGJandK pic.twitter.com/GGV23PAIAJ — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 22, 2026 ****** MJPS/SS/ST (Release ID: 2302363) Visitor Counter : 415 Read this release in: Urdu , Marathi , हिन्दी , Gujarati , Tamil , Malayalam

enrichment.summary: Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir Manoj Sinha met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on 22 August 2026. The Prime Minister's Office announced the meeting via a post on X, with no further details on the agenda or outcomes disclosed.
enrichment.context: Such meetings between the Lieutenant Governor of a Union Territory and the Prime Minister are routine occurrences, often involving briefings on the administrative, security, or developmental situation in the region. Jammu & Kashmir has been under Union Territory status since the reorganisation following the abrogation of Article 370 in August 2019, and the LG plays a key role in the Union Government's oversight of the territory pending full statehood restoration. This release contains no policy announcement, decision, or substantive information beyond confirming that the meeting took place.

related_articles.title: Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh meets Prime Minister
related_articles.relationship: Both are routine PMO announcements of Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories (Ladakh and J&K) meeting the Prime Minister within days of each other, reflecting the same pattern of UT administrative head-PM engagements.
